% \hspace* in math, which the PDF sets as the space of \hspace, as the
% page must: in alignat at the start and in the middle of a row, before
% cases in align, with a space before the brace in \[ \], in equation,
% gather, multline, and split, in inline math, inside \text, in an array's
% column spec, through a macro of the document, in a footnote, in a
% theorem, in a heading and its table of contents entry, in align*, and in
% italic, sans-serif, and typewriter text. Unstarred \hspace, which MathJax
% draws, stays as it is, as do \hspace* in text and in verbatim.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,amsthm}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\newtheorem{theorem}{Theorem}
\newcommand{\gap}{\hspace*{2mm}}
\begin{document}
\tableofcontents
\section{Spaces $a_{1}\hspace*{1em}b_{1}$}
An alignat:
\begin{alignat}{1}
\hspace*{-2mm}a = \hspace*{-0.5mm} b
\end{alignat}
An align before cases:
\begin{align}
\hspace*{-2mm} f(x) = \begin{cases} 1 & x > 0, \\ 0 & \text{otherwise}. \end{cases}
\end{align}
An align*:
\begin{align*}
y_{1} &= \hspace*{1em} y_{2}
\end{align*}
A space before the brace:
\[ c = \hspace* {1em} d \]
An equation:
\begin{equation}
e_{1} \hspace*{3mm} e_{2}
\end{equation}
A gather:
\begin{gather}
g_{1} \hspace*{4mm} g_{2}
\end{gather}
A multline:
\begin{multline}
m_{1} \hspace*{5mm} m_{2} \\ m_{3}
\end{multline}
A split:
\begin{equation}
\begin{split}
s_{1} &= \hspace*{6mm} s_{2}
\end{split}
\end{equation}
Inline, $i\hspace*{1em}j$. Inside text, $\text{k\hspace*{1em}l}$. Through
a macro, $g \gap h$. An array:
\[ \begin{array}{c@{\hspace*{2em}}c} p & q \end{array} \]
In a footnote.\footnote{A note, $n_{1}\hspace*{1em}n_{2}$.}
\begin{theorem}
In a theorem, $t_{1}\hspace*{2mm}t_{2}$.
\end{theorem}
In italic, \emph{$u_{1}\hspace*{2mm}u_{2}$}, sans-serif,
\textsf{$v_{1}\hspace*{2mm}v_{2}$}, and typewriter,
\texttt{$w_{1}\hspace*{2mm}w_{2}$}. Unstarred, $x_{1}\hspace{2mm}x_{2}$.
Text \hspace*{1em} here, and \verb|$a\hspace*{1em}b$|.
\end{document}
